title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 22 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 22 - Imposition of Taxes on Retained Earnings, Reserve, Surplus, etc Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act or any other law for the time being in force, if in any tax year in the income or in any fund, reserve or surplus retained by a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 1994 (Act No. 18 of 1994) and listed on the Bangladesh Stock Exchange, by whatever name it may be called, transfers money from the taxable net income of the previous tax year and the amount of such transferred money exceeds 70% (seventy percent) of the taxable net income of the previous tax year, the amount transferred by the company in that tax year, tax shall be payable at the rate of 10% (ten percent) thereof.
